title: Charts that move
subtitle: A bar chart race, a donut whose slices change, and stacked bars, with made-up numbers

scenes.title: Services by language at a made-up company
scenes.narration: Here is how many services a made-up company ran in each language, year by year.

steps.say: In twenty twenty one, Go more than doubles.
A year later Python passes Java and takes the lead.
By twenty twenty four TypeScript runs the most services, and Rust is growing fast.

scenes.title: One page load, before and after the cache
scenes.narration: This donut splits one page load into its parts. The middle shows the total.

steps.say: Before the cache, the server takes more than half of the load.
With the cache, the server answers in ninety milliseconds, and the whole load drops to about half a second.
Now the download is the biggest part.

scenes.title: Responses a day in thousands, by status
scenes.narration: Each bar is one day of responses, stacked by how they ended.

steps.say: Most responses succeed, about ninety thousand a day.
On Wednesday a bad deploy turned eighteen thousand of them into server errors.
